from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Locate a full-width or full-height separator, then compare the two panels.
    sep_rows=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r]))==1 and h>1]
    sep_cols=[c for c in range(w) if all(all(row[c]==grid[0][c] for row in grid) for _ in [0]) and len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1]
    # Prefer separator which splits grid into equal sized panels.
    if sep_rows:
        r=min(sep_rows,key=lambda x: abs(x-(h-1)/2))
        a,b=grid[:r],grid[r+1:]
        if not a or len(a)!=len(b): raise ValueError('unequal panels')
        bg_a=Counter(v for row in a for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
        bg_b=Counter(v for row in b for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
        return [[2 if a[i][j]!=bg_a and b[i][j]!=bg_b else 0 for j in range(w)] for i in range(len(a))]
    if sep_cols:
        c=min(sep_cols,key=lambda x: abs(x-(w-1)/2))
        a=[row[:c] for row in grid]; b=[row[c+1:] for row in grid]
        if not a or len(a[0])!=len(b[0]): raise ValueError('unequal panels')
        bg_a=Counter(v for row in a for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
        bg_b=Counter(v for row in b for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
        return [[2 if a[i][j]!=bg_a and b[i][j]!=bg_b else 0 for j in range(len(a[0]))] for i in range(h)]
    raise ValueError('no separator')
